text:
alex: quick sync — ACME partner asked how we handle near-SLA overages and what we can send them proactively. they want something before the monthly bill hits.
tara: can we provide a running estimator (24h sliding window) + a calendar-month projection? would help partners avoid surprises.
jing: for marketplace ingestion we only get hourly aggregates from partner side and cloud. typical lag is <2h but we've seen 4-6h backfills during peak. accuracy varies.
alex: @jing good to know. for proposal: send an "estimated usage" payload flagged as provisional, and mark final ledger as source-of-truth.
matt: ops question — if the estimator shows probable >100% of entitlement, do we auto-throttle, auto-credit, or just notify?
ciara: suggest soft approach: 90% alert -> email + webhook to partner; 100% alert -> optional throttling if partner opted in; 110% -> flag for review and possible provisional charge with final reconciliation. :thinking_face:
tara: agree. also include a "confidence" field in the estimator so partners know how much to trust it.
alex: rough example payload to push to partner webhook:
```json
{"customer_id":"cust-ACME-42","period":"2026-04-01T00:00Z/2026-04-30T23:59Z","estimated_usage_units":485120,"entitlement_units":500000,"percent_of_entitlement":97.02,"confidence":0.88,"provisional":true,"generated_at":"2026-04-20T14:12:00Z"}
```
jing: note: confidence calc should account for ingestion lag + sample completeness. might be as simple as 1 - (backfill_rate * 0.5) initially.
marketplace-bot: New ticket created: #MP-4123 — "overage-estimate-feature" (assignee: tara).
matt: runbook items to add: timezone normalization (use UTC), DST handling, final reconciliation window, dispute window (7 days), and ledger authoritativeness.
ciara: policy note — credits only issued after final ledger confirms overcharge and partner dispute window closes. exceptions for clear ingestion errors.
tara: i'll draft a one-pager with thresholds: 90% (notify), 100% (notify + webhook), 105% (optional throttle if partner opted-in), 110% (auto provisional bill + review).
alex: action items: tara -> draft doc + spec for webhook payload; jing -> supply percent backfill metrics and latency histogram; matt -> add ops steps for optional throttle; ciara -> partner policy/credits wording. i'll compile and share with ACME PO.
ciara: i'll schedule a 30m sync with ACME for Wed 09:30 PT.
alex: thanks all. tagging @ACME integration channel once we have doc. :thumbsup:
